policy: Evidence precedes decision. Complete owner means every productive consumer needed for the proposed narrow repair; discovery/glue is not complete semantics. Private carrier revisions are not inferred from runtime. A comparator failure cannot select a cohort.

math-lexical-callee-resolution.causal_hypothesis: Bare MathIdent callee dispatch extracts spelling before consulting the lexical callable. abs/sqrt shadowed by functions returning Content therefore can still take the hardcoded builtin branch. Local/captured scope and generic Content-returning invocation already exist in this owner. Only lexical shadowing is proposed; arbitrary non-Content returns, imported numeric functions, generic math casts and qualified-field spans remain separate.

regression_surface.scope: Math call resolution branch, not scalar formula nor return conversion. A future repair must preserve unshadowed native branches, aliases/captured scope, names that are not functions, warning behavior and argument occurrences. Current Content-only controls isolate this branch.

math-lexical-callee-resolution.refutation: Same-literal shadowed Content-returning abs/sqrt equals vanilla, or source shows lexical binding already used. Any need to revise scopes/Func/Args/public return contract refutes this one-owner scope.
math-lexical-callee-resolution.requires: At least two current shadowed Content-returning controls plus unshadowed and generic-name controls; do not use the numeric alias probe as a proof of this cause.

module-import-error-trace.causal_hypothesis: Imported evaluation propagates errors through ? without adding Tracepoint::Import. Include already transports its analogous trace, the entity already has Import, and L2 formatter handles Import. Narrow addition at imported source evaluation, not resolution/package/include errors, may be one complete owner.

regression_surface.scope: Import evaluation failure trace only; successful imports, include trace and original source error remain unchanged.

module-import-error-trace.refutation: Location-controlled import error already carries the complete trace, or outer formatting/path provenance requires another consumer.

module-redundant-rename-warning.causal_hypothesis: Renaming a bare identifier to itself skips the warning present in vanilla. Existing rename AST/new_name span and sink suffice for a narrowly scoped warning, excluding imported-item rename until independently measured.

regression_surface.scope: One bare rename guard with existing warning transport. Does not change ordinary import or lookup.

module-redundant-rename-warning.refutation: The current redundant-rename observation is equal, or item rename/callback origin requires broader transport.

loader-data-source-missing.causal_hypothesis: Five decoders share resolve_data's detached Portuguese missing-source error; direct/indirect whole-call origin is restricted by transport_native_call_span to different native identities. All five native pointers are already reexported, so no third facade owner is needed. Restrict to no positional/named; named-first precedence remains separate.

regression_surface.scope: Five native identities plus With recursion and source-missing branch. Preserve actual supplied DataSource casts/options/I/O.

loader-data-source-missing.refutation: A decoder's complete missing observable needs distinct identity/trace transport or named validation outside these owners.

loader-path-missing.causal_hypothesis: read has separate PathOrStr missing message and no complete native-call span transport. Existing native_read reexport suffices. This is not the DataSource branch and not read I/O.

regression_surface.scope: Only read empty-argument native/With calls; preserve casts, options and external reads.

loader-path-missing.refutation: Current read missing call equals vanilla, or complete output needs another consumer.

cbor-argument-missing.causal_hypothesis: Empty encoder argument list hits Portuguese detached arity error; pointer-specific span transport is absent. Missing-only must not be conflated with named/excess and indirect cbor.encode identity issues.

regression_surface.scope: Only empty native/With call; no changes to actual serialization or validation precedence.

cbor-argument-missing.refutation: Missing-only With produces an unavoidable extra named trace requiring eval registration ownership; then complete-owner claim is false.

symbol-repr-quote-escaping.causal_hypothesis: Quote variants feed a formatter that escape_debug-escapes characters then escapes double quotes again; this doubles escaping and also exposes Rust-specific single-quote spelling. The public scalar string is already available, so repr-only correction fits this owner. VS/ZWJ rules remain preserved.

regression_surface.scope: Symbol representation string escaping; not symbol value/variant selection, serialization or math rendering.

symbol-repr-quote-escaping.refutation: Current quote repr is equal or correct escape requires upstream lost provenance.

math-limit-operator-text.causal_hypothesis: liminf/limsup table stores ASCII space where ratified native operator text contains U+2009. Current operator Content carrier preserves strings, and observed repr exposes the wrong language text; two bindings share the same table-literal cause.

regression_surface.scope: Two table text values, preserving limits and other operators; rendering may legitimately follow corrected text.

math-limit-operator-text.refutation: Current operator scalar text is already U+2009 or repr discrepancy originates elsewhere.

math-differential-repr.causal_hypothesis: ClassOverride repr uses positional fields and MathStyled outside mono/script erases the wrapper. Dif/dif retain structural carriers but a full correction affects generic class/style/sequence morphology beyond two bindings, so historical small-risk assertion is not reused.

regression_surface.scope: Generic class/style/sequence projection requires broader measured scope; Unknown is not low risk.

math-differential-repr.refutation: A complete targeted projection can be justified from existing variants without name matching and all shared class/style consumers are measured.

cbor-symbol-content-fallback.causal_hypothesis: Symbol/Content go to textual repr fallback rather than dedicated encoding. Symbol has complete scalar value; Content requires its structured serialization surface, not just replace one match branch. Split before proposing any complete repair; historical combined one-owner low-risk cohort is not adopted.

regression_surface.scope: Combined Symbol/Content repair lacks measured complete content-field coverage.

cbor-symbol-content-fallback.refutation: All relevant Content fields are available through an existing canonical interface and generic encoders can reuse it without extra owners.

xml-node-namespace.causal_hypothesis: XML converter emits tag/attrs/children but omits namespace already carried by roxmltree::Node. Existing Dict/None/Str can represent namespace without new entity, changing successful function output deliberately toward language parity.

regression_surface.scope: Namespace key for every converted XML element including absent namespaces and nesting; parser/root/comment behavior remains separate.

xml-node-namespace.refutation: Current namespace probe equals vanilla or fixing complete node result requires root/comment changes beyond namespace.

closure-nonterminal-sink-binding.causal_hypothesis: All positional parameters are consumed before sink remainder, but source sink position is not retained. L0 explicitly preserves this separate debt. A repair requires distinguishing original sink position in closure data and all constructors; historical two-owner/risk claim cannot stand without complete constructor inventory.

regression_surface.scope: Closure representation and public carrier compatibility must be classified explicitly; no architecture proposed.

closure-nonterminal-sink-binding.refutation: Existing data already retains sink position and suffices without modifying public ClosureRepr or other construction owners.
